firm: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco

apply.note: Bank's own student-programs page, which links to the application.

class_year.quote: Our internship and fellowship opportunities at the SF Fed give college and graduate students a chance to experience work life in a vibrant, dynamic, and collaborative environment.

cooling_off.notes: The page carries no sentence addressing reapplication, waiting periods, or a cap on applications. Searched the fetched markup for 'reappl', 're-appl' and 'apply again': no match.

unfiled_quotes.quote: If you’re a recent college graduate or early in your career looking to gain experience at the Fed, apply to our Summer Internship Program.
We offer graduate students the opportunity to interact with research economists and visiting faculty, make progress on their dissertation research, and receive mentorship from senior economists.

provenance.note: This is the thinnest of the Reserve Bank records in this pass. The Bank names who its programmes are for but states no year of study, no application window and no pay, so three of four fields are silent. It is recorded because the class-year sentence is the Bank's own and tier 1, not to raise a count. Sponsorship is silent: the page contains no occurrence of citizen, visa, CPT, OPT, sponsor or work authorisation. That silence is worth noting rather than assuming, because the Federal Reserve Board states a flat citizenship bar and the Atlanta Fed states a CPT position, while this body publishes neither. Silent here means only that nothing is published on the point.
